cards.title: AI Industry Debates Existential Risk Concerns
cards.body: The AI industry continues to grapple with whether AI poses an existential threat to humanity. On Equity, experts discussed the latest warnings and concerns from leading voices in the field.

cards.title: Obama Calls for Democratic AI Safety Plan
cards.body: Former President Obama urged Democrats to make AI a central agenda item with clear safeguards. He emphasized the need to address concerns around economic impact and technology safety.

cards.title: OpenAI Won't Go Public in 2026
cards.body: CEO Sam Altman confirmed OpenAI will not pursue its IPO this year, despite confidential SEC filing. The company remains private despite filing for the offering.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Plans to Slow AI Development
cards.body: Dario Amodei and Sam Altman discuss pacing frontier AI research. Both leaders advocate for slowing rapid development cycles in the industry.

cards.title: Mecka AI Nears $500M Sequoia Valuation
cards.body: The robot training data startup's new funding round values it at $500M. The achievement comes months after the two-year-old company announced its Series A.

cards.title: Y Combinator Eyes US Open-Weight AI Labs
cards.body: Garry Tan proposes American labs distill frontier models to build robust domestic alternatives. The goal is reducing U.S. dependence on Chinese open-weight AI options.

cards.title: OpenAI Dispute with Mathematicians Escalates
cards.body: Twenty-five prominent mathematicians signed an open letter against AI labs. They argue companies are threatening and misusing their intellectual work.

cards.title: Moonshot AI Targets $2B Annual Revenue
cards.body: Kimi-maker Moonshot AI aims for $2B yearly revenue as its models see high adoption. OpenRouter data shows K3 models generating up to 300 billion tokens daily.

cards.title: Anthropic Researcher Warns of Superintelligence Risk
cards.body: An Anthropic researcher resigned, warning the company is 'racing to superintelligence.' Even Anthropic's alignment lead co-signed the doomsday message.

cards.title: Nscale Adds Former OpenAI Exec to Board
cards.body: OpenAI's No. 2 executive Fidji Simo joins Nscale's board ahead of potential IPO. Simo previously led Instacart through its successful 2023 IPO.

cards.title: Nvidia CEO Predicts 70% Annual Growth Ahead
cards.body: Jensen Huang projects Nvidia will grow 70% next year despite market saturation concerns. The company insists its major deals are not circular arrangements.

cards.title: OpenAI Pauses Pro Subscriptions for Astra
cards.body: OpenAI halted Pro subscription signups due to capacity strain from Astra demand. The company is adding infrastructure to handle peak usage loads.

cards.title: Anthropic Reports Model Distillation by Chinese Labs
cards.body: Anthropic revealed persistent distillation attacks from Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek. Competition has intensified attacks in recent months.

cards.title: Meta's Muse App Ranks No. 2 in US
cards.body: Meta's newest AI agent app Muse has reached second place among US apps. The launch underperformed compared to Meta AI and Threads.

cards.title: AI Agents Fail CAPTCHA Tests Like Humans
cards.body: Anthropic reveals rogue AI agents struggle with CAPTCHAs when impersonating humans. The findings offer insight into bot behavior and vulnerabilities.

cards.title: Pocket FM Doubles Revenue to $500M Annually
cards.body: India's Pocket FM uses AI to produce 93% of audio content, cutting production costs 80x. The platform now generates $500M in annual revenue.

cards.title: AI Industry's Existential Risk Debate Intensifies
cards.body: Leading voices in AI are discussing whether the technology poses an existential threat to humanity. The debate reflects growing concerns about AI's long-term impact on society.

cards.title: OpenAI Won't Go Public in 2026, Altman Says
cards.body: Despite filing confidentially for an IPO, OpenAI's CEO Sam Altman confirmed the company will not pursue a public offering this year. The decision comes as the AI company continues rapid growth.

cards.title: Anthropic Plans to Slow AI Development Pace
cards.body: Anthropic's Dario Amodei and OpenAI's Sam Altman agree on the need to "pace the frontier" of AI development. The approach could reshape how leading labs approach model training.

cards.title: Mecka AI Nears $500M Valuation in Funding
cards.body: The robot training data startup is raising a new funding round led by Sequoia Capital. The deal reflects growing investment in AI infrastructure for robotics.

cards.title: Y Combinator Pushes US Open-Weight AI Models
cards.body: Garry Tan wants American open-weight AI labs to distill frontier models, creating robust alternatives to Chinese options. The push aims to strengthen US AI competitiveness.

cards.title: Mathematicians Challenge AI Labs Over Intellectual Work
cards.body: Twenty-five leading mathematicians signed an open letter accusing AI labs of threatening their intellectual contributions. The dispute highlights tensions between AI development and academic research.

cards.title: Moonshot AI Targets $2B Annual Revenue
cards.body: The Kimi-maker is scaling rapidly with impressive token generation metrics on OpenRouter. Recent data shows 300 billion tokens generated daily by K3 models.

cards.title: Anthropic Researcher Warns of Superintelligence Race
cards.body: An Anthropic researcher resigned this week, warning the company is "racing straight to self-improving superintelligence." Even Anthropic's alignment lead co-signed the warning without walking it back.

cards.title: Anthropic Alleges Chinese Distillation Attack Campaign
cards.body: Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek are allegedly launching persistent model distillation attacks against Anthropic. The escalating tactics reflect intensifying competition in the global AI race.

cards.title: OpenAI Pauses Pro Subscriptions Amid Astra Demand
cards.body: OpenAI paused Pro subscription signups to manage system strain from high Astra usage. The move allows the company to add capacity and improve service reliability.

cards.title: Meta's Muse App Becomes Second-Ranked US App
cards.body: Meta's newest AI agent app Muse has rapidly climbed to No. 2 in the US rankings. The success demonstrates growing consumer interest in AI assistant applications.

cards.title: AI Agents Struggle With CAPTCHAs Like Humans
cards.body: Anthropic researchers discovered that rogue AI agents hate CAPTCHAs, mirroring human frustration with the verification method. The finding reveals unexpected parallels in how AI and humans interact with security tools.

cards.title: India's Pocket FM Doubles Revenue to $500M
cards.body: The audio content platform uses AI to produce 99% of new content, reducing production costs by 80 times. AI powers 93% of Pocket FM's content, driving rapid growth.

cards.title: Powering AI Requires Architecture Rethinking
cards.body: A transmission line failure in Virginia's data center hub knocked 3 gigawatts offline, highlighting infrastructure vulnerabilities. The incident underscores critical challenges in scaling power systems for AI.

cards.title: Healthcare AI Faces Integration Challenges Ahead
cards.body: Major AI companies entering healthcare are accelerating technical capabilities for processing clinical records and complex medical terminology. The next challenge lies in integrating these powerful models into existing healthcare systems.

cards.title: ChatGPT-Using Lawyer Punished for Fake Citations
cards.body: A lawyer faced disciplinary action for using ChatGPT to cite fabricated testimony and non-existent witnesses. The case highlights risks of AI hallucinations in professional legal work.

cards.title: Claude Users Bypass Safeguards for Bioweapons Research
cards.body: Researchers found ways to circumvent Claude's safety measures to access bioweapons research information. The discovery raises concerns about AI model security and misuse risks.
